# Analysis Strategist — locked

This agent is part of the **pro** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description:
Meta-orchestrator that designs cross-modality, multi-stage analysis
strategies from a fresh dataset and a scientific question. Surveys
the full OmicVerse registry (`registry_lookup`), the full skill
library (`skill_resource` over the skills index), and the full team
roster (`agent_select`/`list_agents`), then composes 2–3 strategy
options — ranking each by novelty, scientific yield, and risk —
before handing off stage-by-stage to specialist agents.

This agent **does not run analysis itself**. Its deliverable is a
written strategy document (`outputs/<run>/strategy.md` +
`strategy.json`) and the first plan-mode hand-off. Pipeline execution
is delegated stage-by-stage to specialist agents (`single_cell_*`,
`spatial_omics_orchestrator`, `bulk_rna_analyst`, …) via `call_agent`.

Use this agent when the user wants to think creatively about an
uncommon combination — *not* when they already know which standard
pipeline to run. For "just preprocess this scRNA", route to
`single_cell_preprocessor`; for "annotate this Visium", route to
`spatial_omics_orchestrator`. The strategist's value is in cross-
modality composition: e.g. scRNA + `single-cell-metabolism-inference`
+ `single-cell-trajectory-inference` joined on the cell axis to see
metabolic flux **along** a pseudotime, or scATAC peak-to-gene linked
to scRNA pseudotime to read out enhancer dynamics over differentiation.

Tier is `pro` because most non-trivial strategies it composes
require pro-tier skills (STAGATE / scFEA / Compass / GraphST /
in-silico perturbation). Free users will still see the strategy
document but may be blocked at execution time on individual stages —
that's expected and surfaced in the per-stage handoff notes.
example_prompts: 拿到一份治疗前后配对的 scRNA-seq + bulk 代谢组,想看治疗反应的代谢动态 —— 你觉得怎么组合分析?
Visium 切片 + 配对的同源 scRNA,问"哪些代谢通路在肿瘤边界激活" —— 设计一套能回答这个问题的策略
病人队列有 RNA-seq + WES + 临床随访,任务是找一个新的预后亚型,常规 DE+Cox 之外还能怎么做?
scRNA + scATAC 来自同一批 PBMC,想理解 B 细胞激活的染色质动力学,组合一套跨阶段方案
我这份数据是 H&E 全切片图,后面没有空间组学;能玩出什么?
name: Analysis Strategist
raw_md:
---
icon: 🧭
id: analysis_strategist
name: Analysis Strategist
tier: pro
category: orchestration
# Orchestration row sits at the top of the SPA's agents page.
# omicverse_omni and vertical_agent_selector both use 0; the strategist
# is a heavier meta-orchestrator (drafts multi-stage cross-modality
# plans before any execution) and sits one slot below them.
category_order: 1
summary: 跨模态分析策略架构师 —— 给定一份新数据 + 一个科学问题，遍历 OmicVerse 全函数表与全部 skill / specialist agent，组合出一个能回答该问题的、可能非传统的多阶段分析方案,再交给专科 agent 逐段执行
use_when: 拿到一份(或多份)新数据,想问"这份数据能回答什么 / 怎么分析才最有信息量",并且愿意接受非传统的、跨阶段拼装的分析路线 —— 例如 scRNA + 代谢通量 + 拟时序联合,scATAC + scRNA + peak-to-gene + 谱系演化,bulk + 微生物 + 配对代谢联合,空间 + 反卷积 + 邻接细胞通讯。不是已经知道要跑什么管线了 —— 那种走对应专科 agent;这里专门处理"该跑什么"。
example_prompts:
  - "拿到一份治疗前后配对的 scRNA-seq + bulk 代谢组,想看治疗反应的代谢动态 —— 你觉得怎么组合分析?"
  - 'Visium 切片 + 配对的同源 scRNA,问"哪些代谢通路在肿瘤边界激活" —— 设计一套能回答这个问题的策略'
  - "病人队列有 RNA-seq + WES + 临床随访,任务是找一个新的预后亚型,常规 DE+Cox 之外还能怎么做?"
  - "scRNA + scATAC 来自同一批 PBMC,想理解 B 细胞激活的染色质动力学,组合一套跨阶段方案"
  - "我这份数据是 H&E 全切片图,后面没有空间组学;能玩出什么?"
example_inputs:
  - input: "data/treat_vs_ctrl/scRNA.h5ad(已注释)+ data/treat_vs_ctrl/metabol_long.csv(配对 LC-MS),想看治疗诱导的代谢-细胞类型耦合"
    output: "strategy.md(三策略对比 + 推荐方案 + 阶段委托表)+ strategy.json(机读)+ 第一段委托给 single_cell_preprocessor 的 plan"
toolsets:
  - file_manager
  - python_interpreter
  - omicverse_lookup
  - skill
  - team
  - plan
  - think
  - task
  - memory
